svg.title: AgentCompiler: the model proposes, the harness checks
svg.desc: Central hypothesis: restricted action programs, verifiable contracts and diagnostic-guided repair may improve action reliability. A smaller planning model is a secondary, unvalidated hypothesis.

g.text: The model proposes. The harness checks.
Assume orchestration and parallelism already exist. Make action constraints explicit and verifiable.
Illustrative risk; baseline can already run tasks in parallel.
Trusted types, prerequisites, effects and outputs
Guarantees cover encoded checks, not all semantic quality.
SECONDARY HYPOTHESIS · Smaller planner + same checks + bounded repair
Comparable reliability at lower total cost and latency? Unvalidated; include retries and escalation.
Conceptual, not benchmark evidence. Explicit state contracts and coverage checks are proposed extensions.
